scope: Two independently gated SIMLOX 2017 CLI JSON import/export capability probes, each derived from the accepted K01.var04 three-hour single-aircraft model.
behavior_specific_dependency: K01.var04 established the accepted CLI-visible A01-derived model source and native mission behavior. K02 tests JSON structural fidelity on that same model. K01 GUI view and template scope is not a prerequisite for these CLI assertions and remains unverified.

manual.observed_rule: JSON has model/tables/columns/instances; datatype string/integer/double; null blank cells; inactive_rows lists row positions; -jimport/-jexport perform native CLI exchange.
manual.uncertainty: The manual does not specify zero-based versus one-based inactive_rows positions.

inactive: Native -jimport/-jexport preserves all authored table and column names, declared datatypes, keys, instance names, row order, null cells, binary64 double values, and Station.inactive_rows=[1] exactly.

The default Station instance keeps BASE-01 active and K02-INACTIVE unused/inactive; converter errors zero, no new warnings, and the accepted K01 h7 order/h8 launch/h11 completion, 72-bin report and terminal state remain equal.
named: Native -jimport/-jexport preserves two explicitly named Station instances K02-BASE and K02-AUX, their keys/rows/nulls/types, and all other authored tables.
Unused K02-NAMED causes no change to the accepted K01 mission log, 72-bin report or terminal state, with zero conversion errors and no new warnings.

gate: Each arm is accepted or rejected separately against its frozen source and native closure. Any loss of authored metadata, converter error, extra warning, changed mission or invalid output makes that arm diagnostic NO-GO. Neither zero-based indexing nor general multi-instance behavior is claimed before observation.
limitations: A01/K01 GUI views and SXT templates, general K02 JSON forms, inactive rows of other tables, larger precision values, other instance layouts and cross-engine behavior remain unverified.
A successful arm is a bounded K02 CLI slice, not full K02 or automatic prerequisite clearance for K04-K07.
